claim_text: Paired pre/post ICI TROP2 (TACSTD2) rises after immunotherapy (TISMO; Zhejiang IHC H-score 94 -> 121).
public_analog: GSE248249 (Memon et al. Cancer Cell 2024): 13 same-patient NSCLC tumor pairs, PD-(L)1 blockade, pre vs acquired-resistance FFPE Clariom D RNA.

honest_stats.note: Post biopsies are acquired-resistance tumors, not unselected on-treatment or responder residuals. EPCAM control is flat (p=0.79), so the CLDN4 drop is not a simple epithelial-fraction artifact.

secondary_analogs.note: 3 pre + 12 post, different patients, neoadjuvant PD-1+chemo. TACSTD2 slightly lower post (log2FC -0.26, p=0.29) and lower in MPR vs NMPR (p=0.15).
KP and LLC1 ICB-resistant vs parental. Tacstd2 slightly down, not significant. TISMO UI not programmatically downloadable.
Not lung. Responders increase TACSTD2 on-treatment vs non-responders (AUC 0.78, p=0.019, FDR q=0.23).
